headline: Microsoft confirmed attackers exploited an Azure flaw to steal API credentials at Norwegian energy firms as CrowdStrike agreed to buy Zscaler for $43.9 billion.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers now lean on freely copied frameworks like ARTEX and Cairn, turning AI tooling into routine intrusion infrastructure rather than research demonstrations.

topics.title: KEPCO Confirms Breach Hitting 1.5 Million
topics.latest_developments: Korea Electric Power Corporation said a threat actor breached its internal network and reached two systems holding customer, employee, and contractor data on 1.5 million people.
topics.why_it_matters: Attackers got inside South Korea's state-run power utility, handing them identity data that fuels phishing against grid staff and the contractors who service it.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: LaLiga confirmed that hackers stole personal data from users of its services and some affiliated clubs. Austria's Foreign Ministry said intruders accessed names and contact details of staff in Vienna and at missions abroad.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: GlobeTopper, a business-to-business top-up provider, lost an estimated $2.5 million in revenue to an attack that also redeemed $70,000 in digital gift cards.

topics.title: CERT-In Warns of AI-Assisted Bank Fraud
topics.latest_developments: The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team said AI-assisted attacks on technology assets in India triggered unauthorized financial transactions at banks, financial services firms, and service providers.
topics.why_it_matters: Automated attack tooling now drives money out of live payment systems, pushing AI-driven intrusion from research demonstrations into measurable fraud loss.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: Amazon Threat Intelligence says Cairn agents took 11 minutes to turn a medical imaging zero-day into root access on East Asian university servers.

details.label: What to do
details.text: CISA added the Project MONAI MONAI Label path traversal flaw CVE-2026-133968 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on November 23, 2026. Upgrade past version 0.8.5.

topics.title: CrowdStrike Buys Zscaler in $43.9 Billion Deal
topics.latest_developments: CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Zscaler for $43.9 billion, pairing its endpoint detection business with Zscaler's cloud network security platform.
topics.why_it_matters: CrowdStrike expects the combined company to carry more than $10 billion in annual recurring revenue, shrinking buyer options across endpoint and network security.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: Zscaler holders receive 1.135 CrowdStrike shares each, about $260.41 per share, a 34 percent premium to the November 20, 2026 close.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: Chief Executive George Kurtz pitched the deal as a bid to build the largest AI safety and security company, with tighter control over AI agents.

topics.title: Attackers Hijack MSP Technician Hosts
topics.latest_developments: Threat actors exploited ConnectWise ScreenConnect flaw CVE-2026-84869, rated 9.9, against a managed service provider server on November 12, 2026, running payloads on a connecting technician's machine.
topics.why_it_matters: A hijacked technician host hands intruders remote access to every customer that provider manages, turning one compromise into many.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Patch ScreenConnect clients against CVE-2026-84869 and install N-able's fix for CVE-2026-134624, the server-side request forgery bug in Mail Assure.

details.label: What's next
details.text: CISA added the Mail Assure flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on November 23, 2026, putting federal civilian agencies on a fix clock.

topics.title: GL.iNet Patches Cloud Flaw After Backdoors
topics.latest_developments: GL.iNet fixed the GoodCloud remote management flaw on Friday and blocked the attacker's access, and says cleaning infected routers and KVM devices requires new firmware.
topics.why_it_matters: Affected owners reported reverse shells and backdoors on their hardware, so a reboot or factory reset leaves the implant running.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Reflash affected GL.iNet routers and KVM devices with the new firmware. Closing the GoodCloud path stops fresh infections only.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: RemoteToHome Consulting, a GL.iNet services partner, and several users turned up older backdoors during follow-up research. The company still does not know how many devices it lost.

sources.title: GL.iNet Routers, KVMs Compromised via Remote Management Service Flaw
Hackers Exploited GL.iNet Cloud Flaw to Install Malware on Routers and KVM Devices

topics.title: Hackers Exploit Azure Flaw at Norwegian Energy Firms
topics.latest_developments: Microsoft confirmed attackers exploited a flaw in Azure API Management Classic tiers to steal customers' stored API credentials.
topics.why_it_matters: Azure API Management stores secrets for cloud workloads, so one platform bug reached firms that run Norway's oil, gas, and power supply.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Norway's cybersecurity authorities named Equinor and Skagerak Energi as targets and said attackers went after sensitive credentials.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Microsoft has closed the flaw. Authorities say other sectors were hit too, so rotate any secrets held in Azure API Management.

sources.title: Azure Flaw Exploited to Target Secrets at Norwegian Energy Firms
Norway says hackers exploited Microsoft security flaw to attack energy firms Equinor, Skagerak Energi
Microsoft Azure flaw exploited to steal customers' API credentials

topics.title: Attackers Run Root Commands on Cisco Expressway
topics.latest_developments: Russian security company F6 reported that attackers exploited CVE-2026-76466 in Cisco Expressway gateways to breach organizations and reach their internal networks.
topics.why_it_matters: Both Expressway and SAP NetWeaver sit at the enterprise network edge, so root-level command execution gives intruders a staging point for internal movement.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Install Cisco's Expressway and SAP's NetWeaver updates now. CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities listing sets a remediation deadline for federal civilian agencies.

sources.title: SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway Flaws Exploited in Attacks
CISA flags critical Cisco RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks
Cisco Expressway vulnerability exploited to breach internal networks (CVE-2026-76466)

topics.title: Distributors Keep ARTEX Online After Takedown
topics.latest_developments: 404 Media found multiple people redistributing the ARTEX AI hacking framework for anyone to download after its original author apparently pulled the project offline.
topics.why_it_matters: Removing the upstream repository no longer limits access, so defenders should expect continued ARTEX-driven intrusions from criminal crews and state groups.

details.label: What they're saying
details.text: One distributor told 404 Media, "I'm not going to remove the repository."

details.label: Flashback
details.text: CERT-EU identified ARTEX as the tool behind the European Commission intrusion disclosed last week.

sources.title: 'The Code Is Already Copied Everywhere': The AI Hacking Tool Causing Havoc Around the World
“I'm not going to remove the repository”

topics.title: Attackers Exploit ASP.NET Anti-CSRF Library Flaw
topics.latest_developments: Researchers told developers to abandon the legacy Idunno.AntiCsrf library after attackers exploited CVE-2026-131914, rated 9.3, for unauthenticated remote code execution.
topics.why_it_matters: Any ASP.NET application still loading the library hands attackers code execution with no credentials, and the component sits deep inside older web stacks.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Find and remove Idunno.AntiCsrf.dll versions 0.9.1.0 and 0.9.1 Beta. Researchers recommend discontinuing the library rather than waiting for a fix.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: A second library bug landed today: CVE-2026-134814 in binary-parser before version 2.3.1 runs injected JavaScript when an attacker controls parser definitions.

sources.title: Hackers Exploit Critical ASP.NET Anti-CSRF Library Flaw Allowing Unauthenticated RCE
Critical binary-parser Flaw Enables JavaScript Injection via Malicious Parser Definitions

topics.title: Dragos Finds Prompt Theft at Inference Providers
topics.latest_developments: Dragos uncovered undetected intrusions at three AI inference providers after examining nearly two million prompts users sent to AI services.
topics.why_it_matters: Prompts carry source code, credentials, and customer records, so a silent breach at an inference host exposes everything its customers submit.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: The providers never spotted the intrusions themselves, leaving their customers unaware that prompts were walking out the door.

details.label: What's next
details.text: OpenRouter pulled the three providers off its routing platform, saying they violated their stated data-handling policies and exposed sensitive data.

sources.title: AI Inference Providers Failed to Detect Hacking and Prompt Theft, Says Dragos

details.text: Trump made as much as $15 million on Nvidia shares after the 30% jump, the Financial Times calculated from his latest disclosure.

details.label: What's next

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: Nvidia's interim chief executive and senior management learned of the weekend discussions only afterward.

around_teams.title: McCarthy Turns Steelers to Denver Broncos
around_teams.latest_developments: Head coach Mike McCarthy briefed reporters Monday, November 23, ahead of the Steelers' Week 12 game against the Denver Broncos, the team posted.
around_teams.why_it_matters: Fans must plan around a Friday afternoon kickoff carried on a streaming service during the holiday weekend.

details.label: When
details.text: Friday, November 27, 2026, at 3 p.m. Eastern, at home against Denver on Prime Video.

sources.title: Coach McCarthy Press Conference (Week 12 vs Denver Broncos) | Pittsburgh Steelers

around_teams.title: Steelers Players Answer for Eagles Loss
around_teams.latest_developments: Troy Fautanu, Patrick Queen, Max Hurleman, Jaylen Warren, and Roman Wilson took questions on the Week 11 loss at Philadelphia in a Press Pass video the Steelers posted Sunday, November 22.
around_teams.why_it_matters: The session delivers the first player accounts of a defeat that leaves the Steelers facing the same offensive questions raised after the Cincinnati trip.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: The team also posted a short clip Sunday afternoon marking receiver Roman Wilson's return, captioned "Roman is back."

sources.title: Fautanu, Queen, Hurleman, Warren & Wilson on loss at Eagles | Press Pass | Pittsburgh Steelers
Roman is back‼️ 📺: CBS

team_usa.title: Spirit Fire Coach Adrián González
team_usa.latest_developments: The Washington Spirit fired head coach Adrián González on Monday, November 23, after the club lost the National Women's Soccer League Championship for a third straight season.
team_usa.why_it_matters: The Spirit, home to United States forward Trinity Rodman, now hunt for a coach as a World Cup year opens.

sources.title: Spirit fire González after losing NWSL Championship for 3rd straight season

team_usa.title: United States to Co-Host 2031 Women's World Cup
team_usa.latest_developments: FIFA confirmed Monday, November 23, that the United States will co-host the 2031 Women's World Cup, with the United Kingdom awarded the 2035 tournament.
team_usa.why_it_matters: The United States women's national team will play a home World Cup, and American cities gain hosting rights for the sport's biggest women's event.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: The two awards put the tournament in North America and then Britain in back-to-back cycles.

sources.title: U.S. to co-host Women's World Cup in 2031; U.K. wins bid for 2035

team_usa.title: Sullivan Named MLS Young Player of Year
team_usa.latest_developments: Philadelphia Union midfielder Cavan Sullivan won the MLS Young Player of the Year award for his breakthrough season at 17, ESPN reported Monday, November 23.
team_usa.why_it_matters: The award marks the arrival of one of the youngest Americans holding a regular role in Major League Soccer.

sources.title: Philadelphia's Cavan Sullivan wins MLS Young Player of the Year award

team_usa.title: Callaghan Draws USMNT Links After Playoff Loss
team_usa.latest_developments: ESPN profiled Nashville SC head coach BJ Callaghan as a United States men's national team candidate Monday, November 23, a day after FC Cincinnati beat his Supporters' Shield winners 1-0.
team_usa.why_it_matters: Callaghan is the leading American contender to replace Mauricio Pochettino, and a short playoff run would free him for the job sooner.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Cincinnati goalkeeper Roman Celentano made six saves for his fourth clean sheet of the season in the opener of the best-of-three series.

sources.title: How B.J. Callaghan's long, winding coaching journey led to Nashville success
Cincinnati stuns Shield-winners Nashville to start best-of-3 series

team_usa.title: Rodman Rues Third Straight Championship Loss
team_usa.latest_developments: Washington Spirit forward Trinity Rodman said the Spirit's third consecutive National Women's Soccer League Championship defeat hurts far worse than the previous two, ESPN reported.
team_usa.why_it_matters: The result shifts the balance of power in the league that supplies most of the United States women's national team ahead of a World Cup year.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: The Kansas City Current won their first title, and ESPN argued the victory shows sustained investment in women's soccer pays off.

sources.title: Rodman on 3rd straight NWSL Championship loss: 'This one hurts way worse'
Kansas City's NWSL title shows investing in women's soccer pays off
